label: Bible Study
prompt: Out of the same _____ proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
verse: Out of the same mouth proceedeth blessing and cursing. My brethren, these things ought not so to be.
note: Blessing and cursing from the same mouth — James says it shouldn't be so.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my _____, and was with me in the way which I went.
verse: And let us arise, and go up to Beth-el; and I will make there an altar unto God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me in the way which I went.
note: Jacob heads back to Bethel to build an altar to the God who answered him when he was a fugitive in distress.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a _____, and cried out:
verse: But when they saw him walking upon the sea, they supposed it had been a spirit, and cried out:
note: Modern versions say 'ghost'; the KJV says the terrified disciples supposed Jesus walking on the sea was a spirit.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without _____:
verse: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
note: Paul's case from creation: the world is a signed masterpiece, so no one can plead total ignorance of the Artist.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But Mary kept all these things, and _____ them in her heart.
verse: But Mary kept all these things, and pondered them in her heart.
note: After the shepherds' visit, Mary kept it all and 'pondered' — turned it over and over — in her heart.
